description: This file is a JavaScript module implementing the pixelmatch algorithm for image comparison. It defines functions to compare two images pixel-by-pixel, determine differences, and handle anti-aliasing, with configurable options for sensitivity and output styling.

methods.name: pixelmatch(img1, img2, output, width, height, options)
methods.description: Main function to compare two images and produce a diff output, returning the count of differing pixels.

methods.name: isPixelData(arr)
methods.description: Checks if the provided array is suitable pixel data.

methods.name: antialiased(img, x1, y1, width, height, img2)
methods.description: Detects if a pixel is part of anti-aliasing based on neighboring pixel analysis.

methods.name: hasManySiblings(img, x1, y1, width, height)
methods.description: Determines if a pixel has multiple adjacent pixels of the same color.

methods.name: colorDelta(img1, img2, k, m, yOnly)
methods.description: Calculates the perceived color difference between two pixels using YIQ color space.

methods.name: rgb2y(r, g, b)
methods.description: Converts RGB values to luminance (Y) component.

methods.name: rgb2i(r, g, b)
methods.description: Converts RGB to the I component of YIQ space.

methods.name: rgb2q(r, g, b)
methods.description: Converts RGB to the Q component of YIQ space.

methods.name: blend(c, a)
methods.description: Blends a color with white based on alpha transparency.

methods.name: drawPixel(output, pos, r, g, b)
methods.description: Draws a pixel of a specific color into the output image buffer.

methods.name: drawGrayPixel(img, i, alpha, output)
methods.description: Draws a grayscale pixel into the output image buffer based on luminance.
